PluginHostChecks.scope: Host smoke checks including continuous delayed bypass and non-dry selected-program output. Not a sound-quality, allocation, threading, or crash-safety certification. No listening performed.

presetRoute.guidance: Prefer an exposed named program; otherwise select a preset in the native editor and persist Vst3Slot::saveState. Host parameters alone may not construct the processor graph.
presetRoute.candidates: John Mayer; Clapton; King Of Tone; Tube Screamer; ZenDrive (names from upstream source; installed availability and tone unverified)
presetRoute.stateRoute: Upstream BYOD serialises StateManager XML with copyXmlToBinary; .chowpreset contains a proc_chain, not a complete VST3 host state. Do not pass preset XML directly to Vst3Slot::restoreState or invent parameter mappings.
